Confirmed — `src/types/billing.ts` both defines `LimitCheck` and self-references it in `BillingSummary.checks`.

## Summary

I traced every occurrence of `LimitCheck` across the repo and classified each by whether the type is actually named in code (import/type annotation/type argument/satisfies) versus just mentioned in a comment, a manifest-generator string literal, or used only via a factory/call that returns it without naming the type.

**Excluded** (don't name the type):
- `tests/components/usage-meter.test.tsx` — only uses `makeLimitCheck()`, never imports/names `LimitCheck`
- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` — only a comment mention
- `scripts/manifest-parts/domain.ts`, `scripts/manifest-parts/lib.ts`, `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts`, `scripts/build-manifest.ts` — `LimitCheck` appears only inside string literals for a docs manifest, not real TS type references
- `tests/server/plan-limits.test.ts`, `tests/services/billing-service.test.ts`, `src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/usage/route.ts`, `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx` — call `checkLimit()`/read the result but never name `LimitCheck`

**In scope** (name the type via import, annotation, type argument, or satisfies):

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts, src/hooks/org-context.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/usage-meter.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/seat-limit-banner.tsx, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, tests/helpers/factories.ts, tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts
